Subject: MAP kickoff + realistic lead times for Dedicated/Private

Hi Tessa / Aditya,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Zephyr is excited about the throughput on your hosted endpoint. The leadership team asked for a concrete MAP that ties evaluation milestones to procurement and a commit window for Dedicated / Private (we're prioritizing a private deployment for data residency).

Can you help sketch:
- A short MAP with gating criteria (what we need to validate during eval)
- Suggested GPU pool sizing for an initial P0 rollout (we're running a 1.5k rps peak workload for inference across embed + chat flows)
- Realistic lead times for Dedicated vs. on-prem Private (procurement, infra prep, and rollout stages)

We'd like to lock a procurement window by end of May if feasible.

Cheers,
Lara

lara@zephyr.ai

Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + realistic lead times for Dedicated/Private

Lara — thanks, and appreciate the timeline. Below is a concise MAP draft and the high-level capacity plan so your procurement and infra teams can evaluate. I kept the MAP tight so it's usable as a mutual checklist in your procurement packet.

1) MAP: Objectives & milestones (owner / due)
- Eval kickoff: baseline perf/quality tests using your 20k prompt set (Zephyr) — owner: Zephyr / Redwood SRE — due: Apr 20
- Perf gate: median p95 latency <= 220ms (hosted) and token throughput target met on dedicated replica test — owner: Redwood SRE / Karthik — due: Apr 26
- Quality gate: automated evals + sample human pass rate >= 92% on priority prompts — owner: Zephyr / Marissa — due: Apr 28
- Capacity signoff: confirm tranches & commitment window for Dedicated/Private — owner: Zephyr procurement + Aditya — target: May 6
- Procurement & delivery window begins: Trigger purchase order for tranche 1 — owner: Zephyr procurement / Redwood finance — target: May 10
- Private deployment dry-run (staging infra + data ingress test) — owner: Zephyr infra / Redwood eng — target: Jun 14

2) High-level GPU pool sizing (initial P0 launch — safety factor included)
- Workload assumptions you shared: 1.5k peak rps across embed + chat; median token length 60, peak concurrent chats ~350.
- Recommendation (conservative starter):
  * Dedicated (cloud-managed pool): 12 x A100-80GB equiv GPUs (in 3x4 node pods) — supports steady-state + burst margin; recommended autoscale headroom to 18 for peak days.
  * Private (on-prem, single region): 16 x A100-80GB equiv GPUs (4x4 node pods) — accounts for slightly higher infra overhead and on-prem redundancy.
- Rationale: continuous batching, KV cache hit assumptions (~25% prefix reuse) and mixed model family (gpt-class 30B inference) — sizing gives ~1.2–1.6M tokens/min capacity with expected batching patterns.

3) Lead times & milestones (typical)
- Dedicated (Redwood-managed, reserved): procurement -> provisioning to reserved pool: ~4–6 weeks once contract signed (shorter if using existing cloud accounts).
- Private (VPC/on-prem): planning -> HW procurement -> rack & network -> install -> Redwood private install & validation: 12–16+ weeks in most regions. If you choose OEM-managed nodes we can compress to ~10–12 wks but recommend budgeting 14 wks for buffer.
- Note: certificate/KMS and external audit evidence (SOC2 onboarding) can add 2–3 weeks depending on KMS/HSM approvals.

4) Risks & mitigations
- Procurement delays: recommend reserving a cloud-managed Dedicated tranche 1 to hit near-term SLA while private nodes are delivered.
- Model regressions during quantization: include a small canary of unquantized nodes for critical traffic during rollout.

5) Next steps (actionable)
- Aditya: can you share a mutual action plan template with cost tiers for dedicated vs. private? (target: Apr 13)
- Karthik: can you run a quick sizing probe on our test harness with Zephyr's sample dataset to validate throughput assumptions? (target: Apr 15)
- Zephyr: confirm procurement lead (name & PO cadence) and whether on-prem vendor preferred (target: Apr 14)

I'll attach a one-pager MAP and a rough PDF sizing estimate to this thread. Happy to sync in a quick 30-min slot if that helps.

Thanks — t

--
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff + realistic lead times for Dedicated/Private

Adding technical detail for sizing and a quick test plan (short bullets so procurement can digest):

- Baseline probe: we'll run 3 x 10-minute throughput windows with your sample prompts (low/med/high concurrency) and collect p50/p95/p99 and tokens/sec. Please provide API key for staging sandbox (read-only traffic).
- GPU sizing notes:
  * 12 A100-80GB equiv (Dedicated) is our conservative starter estimate. This maps to approx 3 inference pods (4 GPUs each) for easier rolling updates. If we see higher prefix reuse (>35%) we can operate with 10 GPUs.
  * On-prem private: 16 GPUs recommended because of headroom for maintenance windows and heavier orchestration overhead.
- Quantization plan: recommend starting with 8-bit LLM quant (GPTQ-like) on 70% of traffic after quality gating; keep 30% unquantized (fp16) as canary for quality regression detection.
- KV cache strategy: plan for distributed prefix cache on dedicated pool; this reduces steady token compute by ~18–25% for chat-heavy workloads.

I'll run the probe on Apr 15 as Tessa suggested; please confirm sandbox API access and an S3 location for raw prompt set.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Appreciate the detailed plan — this is exactly the level we need. Quick clarifications:
- We'll provide the sandbox key and prompt set by EOD Thu (Apr 14).
- Procurement: I'm leading this; PO cadence is quarterly and we can place a tranche 1 PO in the May 10 window if the perf gates pass.
- On-prem vendor: we prefer using our incumbent integrator (North Ridge Systems) — they can move faster on delivery but we may still hit the 12-week typical lead time.

Two asks:
1) Can you put the MAP into a simple spreadsheet (owners / due dates / acceptance criteria) so my procurement team can attach it to the PO?
2) Please confirm a short contingency plan: if private nodes slip beyond 16 wks, can Redwood hold Dedicated capacity for 60 days post-commencement as a transitional agreement?

If you can get both items in the next 48 hrs we'll plan the internal signoff meeting next week.

Best,
Lara
